blocks.html: Buildings in which plumbing fixtures are installed and premises having drainage piping shall be connected to a public sewer, where available and where connection thereto is feasible. Where neither a sanitary nor a combined sewer is available to which connection is feasible, a private sewer or private sewage disposal system shall be provided. See Section 107.6.1 for required construction documents relating to provisions for discharge for sanitary sewage.
